Emery Moore
Supervisory Immigration Officer, USCIS
Former Refugee

"From former refugee to helping refugees and other benefit seekers, life has come full circle for me. It is really a dream come true to be able to be part of the USCIS mission.  I am most proud of my USCIS family of co-workers who have taken me in and educated me all along how to be a decent human being and public servant.”

#WorldRefugeeDay
